receiver_local_grants.commit_time_revocation: verified (revocation raises PERMISSION_DENIED at transaction boundary)

1_grants_based_fallback_and_caller_trust.finding: The grants-based local fallback in create_local_admission_service operates solely inside trusted receiver application execution. Untrusted wire packages cannot pass `grants` or invoke the local admission service. When `grants=None`, policy permits only repositories; resources, dispositions, sources, and mapping claims are denied closed with PERMISSION_DENIED.

2_dependency_extraction_exception_suppre.finding: In `_extract_context_dependencies`, broad exception suppression does not leak malformed wire data into Context. Preflight validation in `validate_context` (exchange.py:1864) eagerly executes `relation(row)` and `disposition(row)` without exception suppression before any database transaction, ensuring malformed records fail immediately with zero persistent writes. Furthermore, explicit `disposition_key` extraction was added so dispositions are extracted and authorized independently.

3_helpers_deriving_grants_from_package_c.finding: The helper `receive()` in `tests/integration/i3/test_selective_exchange.py` lines 94-112 derives grants from package contents strictly to adapt legacy ADR 0030 test fixtures without rewriting 65 test cases. No production code path derives receiver grants from untrusted package contents.
